edges.carries: the text of the landlord notice
the proposed new rent amount and effective date
the proposed change and how it differs from the current rent payment
the user's approval and the approved rent amount and effective date
the user's decision to decline the change
the updated rent payment amount, effective date, and confirmation status

nodes.name: ReadNotice
nodes.role: read the landlord notice file the user names

nodes.name: ExtractRentChange
nodes.role: determine from the notice the new rent amount and the date it takes effect

nodes.name: CheckAgainstLease
nodes.role: compare the extracted rent change with the rent amount and due date the user currently pays

nodes.name: ConfirmWithUser
nodes.role: ask the user to approve the proposed rent payment change before it is applied

nodes.name: UpdateRentPayment
nodes.role: set the user's recurring rent payment to the approved amount and effective date

nodes.name: ReportResult
nodes.role: tell the user what rent payment change was made, or why none was made
